_meta.indication: WELIREG is indicated for treatment of adult patients with von Hippel-Lindau (VHL) disease who require therapy for associated renal cell carcinoma (RCC), central nervous system (CNS) hemangioblastomas, or pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (pNET), not requiring immediate surgery.

pivotal_trials.design: Ongoing single-arm, open-label, international Phase 2 study; belzutifan 120 mg orally once daily.
pivotal_trials.population: Patients with VHL disease-associated RCC with at least 1 measurable solid RCC tumor and no RCC tumor >3.0 cm requiring immediate surgery; excluded prior systemic anticancer therapy and metastatic disease.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Primary endpoint was confirmed objective response rate (ORR) per RECIST 1.1 by IRC in VHL disease-associated RCC.
pivotal_trials.result: At the primary analysis cutoff, confirmed ORR per RECIST 1.1 by IRC was 36.1% (22/61; 95% CI 24.2, 49.4), all partial responses; median DoR not reached. At an updated cutoff ORR was 49.2% (95% CI 36.1, 62.3).

key_safety: Most common (≥25%) adverse reactions including laboratory abnormalities were decreased hemoglobin, anemia, fatigue, increased creatinine, headache, dizziness, increased glucose, and nausea. In Study 004 anemia occurred in 90% of patients (7% Grade 3). Serious adverse reactions occurred in 15% of patients.
target_moa: Belzutifan is a first-in-class oral small molecule hypoxia-inducible factor 2 alpha (HIF-2α) inhibitor that binds to HIF-2α, preventing its heterodimerization with ARNT (HIF-1β) and subsequent DNA binding, thereby decreasing transcription of HIF-2α target genes that promote tumor survival.

boxed_warning.content: WARNING: EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY — Exposure to WELIREG during pregnancy can cause embryo-fetal harm; verify pregnancy status prior to initiation; advise effective non-hormonal contraception as WELIREG can render some hormonal contraceptives ineffective.

companion_dx_detail: No companion diagnostic device was approved concomitantly with the approval of belzutifan.

description.text: Added new indication for advanced renal cell carcinoma in adults following PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitor and VEGF-TKI therapy

citations.quote: This Prior Approval sNDA provides for a new indication: WELIREG for the treatment of adult patients with advanced renal cell carcinoma following a programmed death receptor-1 or programmed death-ligand 1 inhibitor and a vascular endothelial growth factor tyrosine kinase inhibitor.

description.text: Revised the advanced RCC indication to specify patients with a clear cell component and added final overall survival results

citations.quote: The amended label submitted on September 17, 2024, also includes a revision to the indication statement for use in patients with advanced renal cell carcinoma (RCC) to clarify that the use of the drug product is intended for patients with advanced RCC with a clear cell component (Prior Approval sNDA 011).

description.text: Added indication for adult and pediatric patients 12 years and older with locally advanced, unresectable, or metastatic pheochromocytoma or paraganglioma (PPGL)

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application provides for the use of belzutifan to treat adult and pediatric patients 12 years and older with locally advanced, unresectable, or metastatic pheochromocytoma or paraganglioma (PPGL).

basis.text: The application was reviewed as a Priority review (PDUFA goal date September 15, 2021).

summary.text: Belzutifan received a regular (not accelerated) approval under Priority review, supported by the single-arm Phase 2 study MK-6482-004. The drug had Breakthrough Therapy Designation and Orphan Drug Designation for VHL disease, and was reviewed under Project Orbis.

citations.quote: Regular approval of belzutifan is recommended by all disciplines.
Breakthrough Therapy	23-JUL-2020	FDA DO1 granted BTD to MK-6482.
Orphan Drug Designation Granted	24-JUN-2020	FDA OOPD granted ODD to MK-6482 in the indication of VHL disease; #DRU-2020-7458.
This application was reviewed under Project Orbis in conjunction with MHRA, TGA, and Health Canada.

requirement.text: 4132-3: Conduct an analysis from Study MK-6482-004 to further characterize the incidence and severity of anemia, hypoxia, second primary malignancies and other serious adverse events in patients receiving belzutifan; interim reports annually for 3 years.

citations.quote: 4132-5 Conduct a clinical trial evaluating overall response rate, and duration of response, to further characterize the efficacy and clinical benefit of belzutifan in patients with VHL disease-associated non-RCC tumors, including an adequate number of patients and representation of tumor types, with a minimum of 30 patients in the following subgroups: (1) Pheochromocytoma/paraganglioma and (2) pNET.
